theater: 河北燕京中都及野狐嶺

battle.name: 成吉思汗三路攻金之戰
battle.theater: 河北燕京中都及野狐嶺
battle.brief: 貞祐元年（1213）秋，成吉思汗自漠北出兵，分木華黎、拖雷、合答黑三路南伐。中路越陰山、破野狐嶺與居庸關，圍中都燕京，金宣宗南遷汴京；東路木華黎轉戰河東、河北；北路合答黑直取遼東。卡面的配重投石車正是三路攻城大營的火力骨幹，與撞竿、雲梯同列，決定了燕京與各州府的攻破速度。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 1213年秋天對金的攻勢，是蒙古高原第一次大規模、跨區域的協同出擊，交戰的兩方是蒙古帝國與金朝。金朝此時是北方最大的農業王朝，統治著淮河以北的漢地，以中都（今北京）為都，南面另有南京汴京與汴河，並控制山東、河北、山西等人煙稠密區。它的軍隊以禁軍為骨幹，配上各路元的兵力、漢軍與契丹降兵，攻城倚重固定城防、砲石與火藥器具，後勤靠黃河、桑乾河與驛道轉運糧秣。蒙古一方以成吉思汗的怯薛與各部騎兵為主力，馬兵作戰，步卒多為歸附的漢人、契丹人與色目工匠；野戰補給靠牛羊、乾酪與就地徵發，每名騎手備有多匹馬，帳幕、輜重與攻城器械隨隊轉移。成吉思汗在1211年野狐嶺打散金軍主力之後，趁金朝北防空虛，於1213年秋天一次投入三路大軍，指向河北、山西與遼東三個方向，企圖以同時施壓逼金朝議和，同時把金朝的北方屏障與山西防區徹底拆開。三路並非同出一源：中路是成吉思汗親率的直屬大軍，木華黎一路沿河東的山西高原南下，合答黑一路則從北面進入遼東草原。這種分進合擊的編制，意味著金朝必須同時在數百里長的戰線上分兵應對，而它的北方已經沒有可以再調的預備隊。
countriesEn: The campaign of 1213 was the first large, coordinated, multi-axis offensive the Mongol plateau ever mounted, fought between the Mongol empire and the Jin dynasty. Jin was then the greatest agrarian state in the north, ruling the Chinese lands north of the Huai River with its capital at Zhongdu (modern Beijing), a southern capital at Bianjing on the Bian canal, and control of the dense provinces of Shandong, Hebei and Shanxi. Its field army rested on the imperial guard, supplemented by the troops of the circuits, Han soldiers and Khitan and Jurchen contingents; its sieges depended on permanent fortifications, stone-throwing engines and gunpowder devices, and its supply moved on the Yellow River, the Sanggan River and the courier roads. On the Mongol side the keshig of Genghis Khan and the mounted levies of the tribes did the fighting, with most of the foot soldiers being Han Chinese, Khitan and Central Asian craftsmen who had come over. Field supply came from cattle, sheep, dried milk and requisition on the spot, every horseman rode with several spare mounts, and tents, baggage and siege machines moved with the column. After breaking the main body of the Jin army at Yehuling in 1211, Genghis Khan found the northern defenses of Jin empty and in the autumn of 1213 committed three armies at once against Hebei, Shanxi and Liaodong, in order to force Jin to negotiate while prying apart its northern screen and its Shanxi defensive zone. The three columns did not come from one direction: the central host was led by Genghis Khan in person, Muqali moved south along the Shanxi plateau of Hedong, and Qadaqai entered the Liaodong grasslands from the north. This divided approach meant Jin had to split its forces along a front hundreds of li long, at a time when the north had no reserve left to draw on.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物幾乎都集中在蒙古的核心成員身上。成吉思汗（鐵木真）是全軍統帥，1213年秋在怯綠連河一線誓師，親率中路主力南下，越陰山、破野狐嶺與居庸關，冬天兵臨中都城下，完成蒙古第一次對金朝首都的長期圍困；1214年5月他主動撤圍北返，把河北與山西的攻擊交給木華黎，注意力轉向遼東與中亞。木華黎在1213年被封為太師，專責經略河東，率部連下太原、絳州、潞州，隨後轉入河北與山東，兵鋒直抵汴京以北，1218年病歿於金境，是蒙古在漢地最得力的幹才。拖雷與窩闊台隨中路參戰，1214年2月在塔郭一役中指揮蒙古騎兵包抄金軍，窩闊台其後於1229年接替大汗位。合答黑與也只烈分統遼東一路，掃清金朝在東北的殘餘據點，是這次戰役中最少被記錄、卻決定北方戰略格局的一支。金朝方面，1213年10月完顏合曷發動政變殺死衛紹王完顏允濟，擁立金宣宗完顏珣即位；新君於1214年正月放棄中都南遷汴京，此後又在蒙古壓力下再遷歸德。中原漢人方面，張柔等降蒙將領率部在河北、山西、山東配合攻城，地方豪強與紅襖軍亦乘亂起事，牽制金軍，使北方戰線更加破碎。
peopleEn: The key figures of this campaign were almost all drawn from the Mongol core. Genghis Khan (Temujin) was the commander of everything: he mustered at the Kerulen in 1213, led the central host south across the Yin Mountains, through Yehuling and Juyongguan, and in the winter stood before Zhongdu, completing the first long siege of a Jin capital by Mongol troops. He lifted the siege and withdrew north in May 1214 of his own accord, leaving Hebei and Shanxi to Muqali and turning his attention to Liaodong and Central Asia. Muqali was created taishi in 1213 and given responsibility for Hedong; he took Taiyuan, Jiangzhou and Luzhou in turn and then swung into Hebei and Shandong as far as the country north of Bianjing, dying of illness in Jin territory in 1218, the most effective of the Mongol commanders in the Chinese lands. Tolui and Ogedei served with the central host, and in February 1214 they directed the Mongol cavalry that enveloped the Jin relief army at Tamu; Ogedei succeeded as great khan in 1229. Qadaqai and Yizhilie led the Liaodong column, clearing Jin outposts in the northeast; it is the least recorded of the three armies, yet it is the one that fixed the strategic shape of the northern theater. On the Jin side, in October 1213 Wanyan Hada seized power in a coup and killed the ruler Wanyan Yunji, enthroning Emperor Xuanzong Wanyan Xun; the new court abandoned Zhongdu and moved south to Bianjing in the first month of 1214, and was driven on to Guide again later under Mongol pressure. Among the Han Chinese of the north, surrendered officers such as Zhang Rou operated with the Mongols in Hebei, Shanxi and Shandong alongside the sieges, while local magnates and the Red Coat bands rose in arms, tying down Jin garrisons and fragmenting the northern front further.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車（Trebuchet）正處在蒙古攻城體系的核心位置。配重式投石車在長臂末端吊著配重箱，靠箱體下墜的勢能甩出臂頭的石彈，把石頭拋進城頭、樓櫓與城門之上；歐洲與中亞在十二世紀已普遍使用這類器械，中國自北宋以來也有同樣原理的砲車，金、元文獻稱之為砲車、拋石車，蒙古人則大量徵用被征服地區的匠人來操作。1213年三路大軍各自隨軍攜帶成批攻城器械：壕溝先用土石與枯木填平，牆根用撞竿反覆撞擊，雲梯靠近後，砲車集中在同一段城牆連續射擊，把女牆、樓櫓與守軍陣地逐次打爛，再由突騎與步卒從缺口湧入。1212年蒙古攻薊州時，金守軍用火藥砲與震天雷摧毀了蒙古的攻城器械，迫使大軍退兵，1213年的攻勢因此更倚重集中砲火與坑道，攻城技師在每次拔營前都要重新計算射程、配重與投射角度。除投石車外，蒙古騎軍使用複合反曲的蒙古弓，箭鏃以鐵製，長槍、大刀與鐮刀配以皮甲與札甲；金軍的守城器械除砲石外，還有強弩、拒馬、鐵蒺藜，以及火藥陶甕製成的震天雷與燃燒用的飛火牌。運輸依靠馬匹、牛車與帳幕，冬季則利用封凍的河面與雪地通行，把砲車、木料與糧草運到城下。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card sat at the core of the Mongol siege system. A counterweight trebuchet hangs a weight box on the end of a long arm; the fall of the box drives the stone off the other end and throws it over walls, towers and gates. Such engines were in general use in Europe and Central Asia during the twelfth century, and China had machines working on the same principle from Northern Song times; Jin and Yuan documents call them paoche or throwing carts, and the Mongols took over craftsmen from the conquered regions to work them. In 1213 each of the three columns marched with batches of siege equipment: ditches were filled with rubble and brush, walls were battered with beams, scaling ladders came up, and the trebuchets were concentrated on one section of wall to fire continuously, smashing the parapet, the towers and the defenders' positions piece by piece before cavalry and foot poured through the breach. When the Mongols attacked Jizhou in 1212 the Jin garrison destroyed their siege engines with gunpowder bombs and thunder crash bombs and forced the army to withdraw; the offensive of 1213 accordingly relied even more on concentrated artillery fire and sapping, and the engineers had to recompute range, counterweight and angle of release before every move of the camp. Beyond the trebuchet, Mongol horsemen used the composite recurved Mongol bow with iron arrowheads, and carried spear, sword and sickle with leather and lamellar armour; the Jin defenders answered with stone-throwing engines, heavy crossbows, cheval-de-frise, caltrops, and the gunpowder-filled ceramic jars known as thunder crash bombs together with incendiary fire plates. Everything moved on horses, ox carts and wagons, and in winter the frozen rivers and snow roads carried the engines, timber and grain to the walls.
tactics: 蒙古這場戰役的戰術核心是分進合擊與高機動迂迴。中路大軍不取險徑直趨幽燕，而是先沿漠北草原南下，經陰山、拿狼山，到野狐嶺與中都之間唯一可通車隊的通道，扼住金朝山西與河北援軍的咽喉；破居庸關後立刻合圍中都，斷金朝南北聯繫。木華黎一路完全走高原路線，越太行入山西，攻太原、絳州一帶的險要州府，再翻太行阻隘向河北、山東推進，逼迫金廷必須在兩翼同時佈防。合答黑一路以輕騎掃蕩遼東，攻取廣寧、遼陽等據點，消滅契丹殘部與遼東守軍，使金朝失去東北屏障。三路彼此不相互呼應，卻製造全面崩潰的錯覺，迫使在沒有兵源與糧秣補充的金朝分兵。圍城期間蒙古施行長圍，封鎖城郊，斷絕援軍與糧道，挖掘坑道，並以壕溝封鎖城門；金廷自汴京派出二十萬援軍時，蒙古以佯退誘敵深入黃河渡口一帶，再合圍擊潰，援軍主力於塔郭一戰全沒。防守方則憑城堅守，砲石與火藥齊發，把蒙古的攻城器械逐次摧毀，並以突騎出城擾亂蒙古糧道與工地，試圖拖到春天洪水封住蒙古營地。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the campaign was division of effort combined with rapid manoeuvre. The central host did not take the direct road to the lands of You and Yan; it moved south across the steppe, over the Yin Mountains and the Lang Mountains, to the one gap between Yehuling and Zhongdu through which wagons could pass, seizing the throat through which Jin reinforcements from Shanxi and Hebei must come. Once Juyongguan was taken the army at once ringed Zhongdu and cut the north-south link of the Jin court. Muqali's column went entirely by the high road, over the Taihang into Shanxi to attack the strong prefectures of Taiyuan and Jiangzhou, then climbed back over the Taihang passes into Hebei and Shandong, forcing the Jin court to garrison both wings at once. Qadaqai's column swept Liaodong with light cavalry, taking outposts such as Guangning and Liaoyang, breaking the remaining Khitan bands and the Liaodong garrisons, and depriving Jin of its northeastern shield. The three columns did not support one another, yet they created the impression of general collapse, forcing a Jin that could neither replace men nor grain to divide itself. During the siege the Mongols invested the city, sealed the countryside around it, cut off relief and supply, drove saps, and closed the gates with ditches and barriers. When Jin marched twenty thousand tens of men out of Bianjing to relieve Zhongdu, the Mongols feigned retreat, drew them deep toward the Yellow River crossings, then closed the net; the relief army was destroyed at Tamu. The defenders on their side held behind their walls, firing stone and gunpowder, wrecking the Mongol engines piece by piece, and sending out cavalry to harry the Mongol supply lines and works, hoping to hold out until the spring floods sealed the Mongol camp.
data: 關於這場戰役的數字，現存史料留下的空白比記載更多。三路大軍的總兵力，元代史書沒有給出可靠數目，《元史·太祖紀》只記分三軍而不列人數，木華黎一路被記為兵稍多；按當時蒙古各部落的動員規模推估，總數當在數萬至十餘萬之間，這只能當作量級而不是確數。相對可考的是金朝的應援兵力：1214年2月，金廷自汴京發兵二十萬北上救中都，兵至黃河南岸的塔郭便全軍潰散，這個二十萬出自金方記錄，但也包含了沿途徵發與臨時編入的部隊。空間尺度上，中路大軍自漠北怯綠連河一線的集結地直抵中都，直線距離接近一千公里，迂迴行軍的實際路程更長；野狐嶺距中都約一百二十里，是自西北進入燕雲的孔道，蒙古軍破嶺之後才得以展開攻城器械。時間上，蒙古大軍於1213年秋出兵，秋天抵達中都城下，圍城歷時約半載，1214年5月才拔營北返。城池尺度方面，《金史·地理志》所載中都城垣周約三十五里，外城與內城相套，闢有門若干，單是中都一座便需要數十座砲車同時操作才能壓制城頭火力。三年之間，河北、山東、山西失陷的州縣以數十計，金朝交出的城邑、糧秣與俘虜數量遠超一次會戰所能承載的規模，而這些數字在雙方記錄中同樣互相矛盾。
dataEn: As for the numbers of this campaign, the gaps in the record are larger than the record itself. The total strength of the three armies is not given reliably in the Yuan histories: the Taizu annals of the History of Yuan note only that the army was divided into three, without listing men, and Muqali's column is described merely as having somewhat more men than the others. Judging by the mobilization capacity of the Mongol tribes at that time, the total must have run from several tens of thousands to a hundred thousand or more; that is an order of magnitude, not a figure. Better documented is the Jin relief force: in the second month of 1214 the Jin court marched twenty thousand tens of men north from Bianjing to save Zhongdu, and they broke at Tamu on the south bank of the Yellow River. That figure of two hundred thousand comes from the Jin side and includes detachments raised along the road and troops enrolled on the spot. In spatial terms, the central host went from the mustering ground along the Kerulen in the northern steppe to Zhongdu, a little under a thousand kilometres as the crow flies and rather more by the winding line of march; Yehuling lies about one hundred and twenty li from Zhongdu and is the gap through which the northern approaches into the Yan-Yun region enter, and only after breaking it could the Mongols deploy their siege engines in earnest. In time, the army set out in the autumn of 1213, reached the walls of Zhongdu that same autumn, kept up the siege for roughly half a year, and did not break camp and go north until May 1214. As for the size of the city, the Geography treatise of the History of Jin gives the circuit of the walls of Zhongdu as about thirty-five li, with an outer and an inner enceinte and a number of gates; a single Zhongdu required several tens of trebuchets working at once to overwhelm the fire from the parapets. In the three years that followed, the number of prefectures and counties lost in Hebei, Shandong and Shanxi ran into the tens, and the towns, grain and captives surrendered by Jin far exceeded what any one pitched battle could have carried; the figures in the two sides' records contradict one another here as well.
cause: 蒙古這次大舉攻金，有遠因也有近因。遠因是十餘年來草原各部與金朝在邊境上的衝突：互市受限制、馬匹被扣、使者被殺，商路與牧場都被擠壓，木華黎、闊里吉等人早年的掠奪又加深了對立。近因則是1211年野狐嶺一戰之後，金朝雖然丟掉北方主力，卻拒絕歸還蒙古俘虜、拒絕議和，也拒絕成吉思汗提出的條件，即交出工匠與糧食，協助蒙古先滅遼國。成吉思汗的算盤很清楚：遼東與契丹餘部仍在遼河一帶活動，若不先滅遼，金朝就有可乘之機；金朝不肯供應，1213年秋天他便以追索叛逃人口與工匠為名，同時在河北、山西、遼東三面下手，把一次邊境衝突放大成三路大軍的全面進攻。金朝內部的變數同樣重要：1213年10月完顏合曷發動政變殺死衛紹王完顏允濟，扶立金宣宗完顏珣，新朝廷忙於清洗與部署，北方防務一連數月無人主帥；中都守軍只能靠城牆與火藥器具硬撐，等到援軍出城時已經錯過主動出擊的時機。金朝同時還要在黃河南岸保住汴京這個糧源與稅源中心，兵力調度自此陷入兩難，攻則糧草不繼，守則北方盡失，這正是三路大軍能夠同時推進的結構性原因。
causeEn: The great Mongol offensive against Jin had both a distant cause and an immediate one. The distant cause was a decade of friction along the steppe frontier: the fur trade restricted, horses confiscated, envoys killed, trade routes and pastures squeezed, worsened by the earlier raiding of men such as Muqali and Kölji. The immediate cause lay in what Jin did after the battle of Yehuling in 1211. Though it had lost the bulk of its northern army, Jin refused to return Mongol prisoners, refused to negotiate, and refused Genghis Khan's conditions: handing over craftsmen and grain so that the Mongols could finish off the Liao first. Genghis Khan's reasoning was plain. Khitan remnants were still active along the Liao river in Liaodong, and unless the Liao were destroyed first, Jin would have a gap to exploit. Jin refused to supply, so in the autumn of 1213 Genghis Khan used the pretext of chasing fugitives and claiming craftsmen as the reason for striking in three directions at once, in Hebei, Shanxi and Liaodong, turning a border quarrel into a general invasion. The instability inside Jin mattered just as much. In October 1213 Wanyan Hada carried out a coup and killed Wanyan Yunji, seating Wanyan Xun on the throne; the new court was occupied with purges and appointments, and for months the northern command went unled. The garrison of Zhongdu could only hold on behind its walls with gunpowder devices, and by the time the relief army was let out of the city the moment for a counterstroke had passed. Jin still had to keep Bianjing on the south bank of the Yellow River, that reservoir of grain and tax, so its forces could be neither concentrated nor dispersed: to attack was to run out of supply, to stay was to lose the north. That was the structural reason three armies could advance at the same time.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是金朝的北方防線在一年之內整體垮塌。1214年5月成吉思汗撤出中都，木華黎與合答黑繼續在河東、河北與遼東掃蕩，到1215年遼陽陷落，遼東五州相繼而降，其後中京大寧府與興中府一線也落入蒙古之手，中都燕京成為蒙古在南方的前沿。金廷退保河南，先遷汴京，其後再遷歸德，最終退到蔡州，北方原有的兵源、馬匹、耕牛與賦稅全部斷絕，只能靠南方運糧維持軍隊，而留守河南的兵越多，民間的負擔就越重。對蒙古而言，這場戰役的收穫同樣超出戰場：大批漢地與回回的匠人被徙往漠北，鐵匠、木匠與攻城技師成為蒙古自己的工官隊伍；蒙古由此掌握了攻守大城的完整技術，隨後滅西夏與西征花剌子模時所用的雲梯、砲車、坑道與火藥器具，都源於此役累積的經驗。戰略模式也從此定型：先用多路大軍分割敵人防區，再以集中砲火破一城、迫一國議和，之後以歲幣與割地換取一個可以持續掠取的秩序。北方漢地因此長期淪為騎兵與屯田交錯的地區，張柔、紅襖軍等武裝相繼興起，社會秩序在十年之間難以重建。對後世而言，這是蒙古第一次把用戰爭改寫北方政治格局變成可複製的方法，1213年的三路大軍，也就成了歐亞草原文明與農耕文明碰撞中最典型的一場示範。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the campaign was the collapse of the whole northern defense line of the Jin dynasty within a single year. Genghis Khan withdrew from Zhongdu in May 1214, and Muqali and Qadaqai went on sweeping Hedong, Hebei and Liaodong; by 1215 Liaoyang had fallen and the five prefectures of Liaodong surrendered one after another, and later the line of Zhongjing Daning fu and Xingzhong fu also went over, leaving Zhongdu, Yanjing, as the Mongol frontier in the south. The Jin court withdrew behind Henan, moving first to Bianjing and then to Guide, and finally back to Caizhou; the northern sources of soldiers, horses, draught oxen and taxation were cut off entirely, so the court could only keep the army supplied from the south, and every unit kept in Henan weighed heavier on the people. The Mongols gained just as much as they had asked for. Large numbers of Han and Central Asian craftsmen were moved to the steppe, and smiths, carpenters and siege engineers became the Mongol administrative engineering corps; the Mongols now possessed the full technique of assaulting and holding great cities, and the ladders, trebuchets, saps and gunpowder devices used later against the Western Xia and against Khwarazm grew out of what was learned in this campaign. The strategic pattern was also fixed from then on: divide the enemy's defense zones with several armies, break one city with concentrated artillery fire, force one state to the negotiating table, and then buy a continuing order of plunder with tribute and ceded land. The northern Chinese lands became for a long time a zone where horsemen and colonists intermingled, and armed groups such as those of Zhang Rou and the Red Coat bands rose in succession, so that social order could not be rebuilt within a decade. For later ages this was the first time the Mongols turned the rewriting of the northern political order by war into a method that could be copied, and the three armies of 1213 became the most typical demonstration of the collision between steppe and agrarian civilizations across Eurasia.
result: 三路大軍都達到了各自的目的，但都沒有佔領全部土地，這是1213年攻金的結果特徵。中路軍完成了對中都的包圍，1214年正月金宣宗放棄燕京南遷，蒙古第一次迫使金朝放棄首都；1214年2月金廷派出的二十萬援軍在塔郭被擊潰，二十萬的損失使金朝再也無力在北方組織一次反擊；3月隆興和議訂立，金朝以退讓換取暫時停兵，5月成吉思汗拔營北返，帶走大量糧秣與器械。木華黎一路在和議之後並未停止，1214年至1218年間相繼打下山西、河北與山東的數十座州縣，中都以西、以北的地區基本淪為蒙古的牧地與駐軍區；合答黑一路在遼東取得廣寧、遼陽等城，把契丹餘部徹底掃清，也把金朝在東北的邊防掏空。和議之後，蒙古每年從金朝取得銀、絹、粟等物資與大批被擄人眾的贖金，中都與河北一線的居民被大量驅往漠北。戰役的直接勝負是蒙古完勝：金朝失去首都與整個北方，軍心與政令在遷都與政變之間反覆折損；代價則是金朝從此淪為偏安的王朝，苟延到1234年蔡州之敗才真正滅亡。對蒙古自身，這場勝利確立了成吉思汗以來的三路用兵法，也讓蒙古第一次獲得足以支撐長征的攻城技術與工匠隊伍，1219年西征時的雲梯、砲車與攻城器械，正是從中都與遼陽的攻城工匠那裡得來的。
resultEn: All three armies achieved what they were sent for, and none of them took all the ground there was to take; that is the particular shape of the outcome in 1213. The central column completed the investment of Zhongdu, and in the first month of 1214 Emperor Xuanzong abandoned Yanjing and moved south, so that the Mongols for the first time forced the Jin to give up its capital. In the second month of 1214 the twenty thousand tens of men the Jin court sent out were destroyed at Tamu, a loss that left Jin unable ever again to organize a counteroffensive in the north. A truce was concluded in the third month, Jin buying a pause with concessions, and in May Genghis Khan broke camp and went north, taking with him a great quantity of grain and equipment. Muqali's column did not stop after the truce: between 1214 and 1218 it took several tens of prefectures and counties in Shanxi, Hebei and Shandong, and the country west and north of Zhongdu passed in practice into Mongol pasture and garrison ground. Qadaqai's column took Guangning and Liaoyang in Liaodong, swept the last of the Khitan bands away, and hollowed out the Jin defense in the northeast. After the truce the Mongols drew silver, silk, grain and the ransom of great numbers of captives from Jin every year, and the people of Zhongdu and the Hebei line were carried off to the steppe in large numbers. The direct verdict of the campaign was an outright Mongol victory: Jin lost its capital and its whole north, and the morale of the army and the authority of the orders wore down between migration and coup. The price was that Jin became a state living in a corner, surviving until its real end at Caizhou in 1234. For the Mongols themselves the victory confirmed the three-column method Genghis Khan had used since 1211 and gave them, for the first time, the siege technique and corps of engineers that would support a campaign of conquest, and the ladders, trebuchets and siege gear used in the westward campaign from 1219 came from precisely the siege craftsmen of Zhongdu and Liaoyang.
